name: CAP-U10PADPREDICT
question: The fit pad (fitLayout, #481): content heights chosen near a row boundary, where pads from 25.1 to 36.3 give different rows. Six Texts alone on Blocks Probe, each picked at layouts 2 and 4.

rules.F: A fitted block takes the fewest rows n whose height, 41.09 x n - 11, holds its content height plus 30px. The section rows are the end line plus 3 (layout 2) or 1 (layout 4). Fitted on CAP-U10TEXTMIX-B.json and -D.json, the pad from 25.1 to 36.3 fitting all (seen).

scoring: Per read: the span F gives for the content height read there (contentH), and the rows. The contentH predicted here comes from ours and is not scored; padRange is the pads that give the predicted span for that contentH. splits: whether 25.1 and 36.3 give different spans there.
score: Round 1: 6 of 12, scored the same on the content heights read there and on the predictions. Misses: H3 and HL3 at layout 2 end at line 11 (6 rows, rows 14) though their content needs 9 and 10; HL3 at layout 4 takes 11 rows where 30px gives 10 (needs 32.0 or more); Q3L at layout 2 takes 17 where 30px gives 16 (needs 30.6 or more); H4L (two headings) splits into two blocks, H1 and H4, at both picks, so the one-block prediction misses twice. Refit 1 is in CAP-U10PADREFIT1.json.
